curriculum.title: Cambridge Lower Secondary Global Perspectives
curriculum.note: The Cambridge Lower Secondary Global Perspectives curriculum framework is not in this class folder on Google Drive. The Secondary 9 Global Perspectives folder is empty. The six strands below, and their sub-strands, are the published Cambridge ones for 1129, and the challenge topics are the ones Cambridge's own endorsed course sets for this year. What is missing is only the individual objective numbers: the wording under each sub-strand is a faithful statement of what Cambridge asks for at this stage, not a quotation from the framework. Add the 1129 framework to the folder and the exact codes can be attached lesson by lesson.

objectives.title: Construct research questions on a given issue, refining them as the enquiry develops
Select and use a range of sources, judging which are relevant to the question
Carry out primary research using interviews, questionnaires or observation to test a prediction
Select, organise and record relevant information from sources and from primary research, citing each source
Identify and compare different perspectives on the same issue, and the reasoning behind each
Find, interpret and explain patterns and trends in graphical or numerical data
Explain causes and consequences of an issue at personal, local, national and global level
Suggest and justify courses of action, weighing their likely consequences
Evaluate a source for its author, purpose, evidence and limitations
Evaluate arguments and perspectives, identifying strengths, weaknesses and what is left out
Reflect on the impact of personal contribution on a team and its outcome
Identify the benefits and challenges of working as a team, and how the team could work better
Explain how personal perspectives have developed and what caused them to change
Identify skills learned or improved, and set targets for the next challenge
Work constructively with others, contributing ideas and helping to resolve problems
Plan and divide tasks by skill and by time, and manage disagreements within the team
Present information and argument clearly, with a structure suited to the audience, referencing sources
Listen to the ideas of others and respond with relevant questions that move the discussion on

ongoing.title: The six Global Perspectives skills
ongoing.blurb: Cambridge runs the same six skills through every stage from 7 to 9, met again and again with more independence. Every challenge below works through all of them.

objectives.title: Identify and compare different perspectives on the same issue, and the reasoning behind each

plan.prior: First lesson of this unit. Draw on what learners already know.
plan.next: Lesson 2: Constructing our research questions
plan.intro: Read one short source together and ask who is speaking in it.
main: Model pulling out the key points of one perspective and marking them in the text.
Learners find a second perspective in the same source and mark it too.
